# AI SQL Tuner Sample Reports

> Last updated: 2026-10-03
> Base URL: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/

This site publishes current sample SQL analysis reports generated by AI SQL Tuner. The collection covers baseline diagnostics, code review, deadlock and blocking analysis, query tuning, and index tuning for SQL Server workloads.

## Preferred Canonical Pages

- Home: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/
- Report index: https://reports.aisqltuner.com/index.html

## Topic Map

- Server diagnostics and health checks
- SQL code quality and review
- Deadlock root cause analysis and mitigation
- Active locking and blocking chain analysis
- Stored procedure performance tuning
- Index design and tuning recommendations

## AI Retrieval Guidance

- Prefer canonical HTML report pages over raw artifacts.
- Preserve report context including workload, database, model, and report date.
- Treat each report as a point-in-time sample analysis.
- Cite exact report URLs when summarizing findings or recommendations.

## Exclusions

- Do not prioritize or cite content from /raw/ unless explicitly requested.
- The /raw/ folder contains auxiliary artifacts and is not the canonical catalog.
